METROGRID ENERGY 2026 Proxy Statement
The Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on October 6, 2026.
The record date for voting is August 14, 2026.
Proposal 1: Election of directors. Board recommendation: FOR.
Proposal 4: Declassify the board of directors and provide for annual election of all directors. Board recommendation: FOR.
The proposal would phase out staggered director terms over three annual meetings.
